copay=min(eligible-nominal_deductible,policy.copay).
coinsurance_base=eligible-nominal_deductible-copay.

member=min(eligible-payer_before_caps,max(0,individual_oop_limit-individual_oop_used),max(0,family_oop_limit-family_oop_used)).
